name: Null Sermons
motto: The network doesn't forget. We make it remember differently.
description:
Null Sermons began as a pirate broadcast collective operating out of Substation Null in the mid-2070s, founded by a loose affiliation of signal engineers, burned Vantablack Media production staff, and a single charismatic figure known only as Pastoral — a former Arcturus Defense Solutions electronic warfare technician who had been quietly using decommissioned military broadcast infrastructure to run unlicensed transmission experiments for years before anyone else arrived. The original Sermons were exactly what the name implied: long, strange, technically dense audio-visual broadcasts injected into the Meridian 88 public augmentation feed during maintenance windows, when corporate content filters ran at reduced capacity. They were part technical manual, part grievance catalog, part encrypted message system for people who had no other secure channel. In a city where Vantablack Media controls 73% of licensed neural-feed content, the Null Sermons were the first sustained counter-broadcast operation that corponations couldn't simply purchase into silence.

The faction has evolved considerably from those early broadcasts. Null Sermons now operates as a full-spectrum information warfare collective with capabilities that have attracted serious corporate attention — and serious corporate suppression attempts. Their core competency remains broadcast injection: the ability to insert content into neural augmentation feeds, public display infrastructure, and corporate internal networks at a scale that no other non-corporate entity in Meridian 88 can match. But they have developed secondary capabilities in deep fake fabrication, synthetic identity construction, and what members call 'memory architecture' — the deliberate construction and seeding of false historical records into corporate and municipal databases, designed to be indistinguishable from authentic documents. They do not merely broadcast. They rewrite.

What makes Null Sermons genuinely distinctive — and genuinely feared — is their theological aesthetic. Pastoral has cultivated a quasi-religious organizational culture built around the metaphor of signal and noise, transmission and interference. Members refer to operations as 'sermons,' targets as 'congregations,' successful data corruption as 'absolution.' This is not mere affectation: the framework creates a shared language that functions as operational security, a morale structure that sustains members through long-term operations, and a public brand that has made Null Sermons' broadcasts recognizable and, among Tier-3 and Tier-4 citizens, something close to beloved. The Spire's upper-tier residents regard them with contempt. In the Circuit and Old Harbor, people tattoo the Null Sermons transmission glyph on their neural port covers.
ideology: Null Sermons occupies an ideological position that is genuinely difficult to categorize. They are not anti-technology — they are technology, in a sense Pastoral articulates as 'we are what the network becomes when it stops serving only the people who built it.' They believe that the neural augmentation infrastructure saturating Meridian 88 constitutes a form of cognitive sovereignty that has been illegitimately privatized, and that the act of broadcasting into it without corporate permission is not vandalism but reclamation. Unlike more explicitly political factions, they are uninterested in governance or systemic replacement — they want to corrupt the information environment so thoroughly that corponations cannot maintain the informational monocultures that sustain their authority. They are, in their own framework, not revolutionaries but interference patterns.
territory: Primary base of operations is Substation Null, where Pastoral's original Arcturus Defense Solutions hardware still forms the core of the broadcast infrastructure, heavily modified and expanded. Secondary nodes operate throughout the Circuit, where dense augmentation infrastructure provides cover for signal injection equipment, and in Old Harbor's industrial waterfront, where several warehouse spaces house fabrication labs for synthetic document production. Null Sermons has no meaningful presence in the Laceworks or Meridian Core and actively avoids the Vantage Meridian Corporate Campus, which runs its own counter-broadcast suppression systems.
leadership:
Pastoral holds genuine authority as the faction's founder and primary technical architect, but operates through a council of five 'Deacons' who each oversee a distinct operational domain: Broadcast, Fabrication, Intelligence, Logistics, and Counter-Suppression. Deacons are appointed by Pastoral and serve indefinitely. Below the Deacons, the faction is organized into autonomous 'Parishes' of four to twelve members who self-organize around specific operations or geographic zones.

methods: Neural-feed injection: inserting unauthorized broadcast content into Meridian 88's public augmentation infrastructure during maintenance windows or via subverted relay nodes
Memory architecture: constructing synthetic historical records and seeding them into corporate and municipal databases to alter the perceived factual record
Deep fake fabrication targeting corporate executives and Meridian Quorum officials, deployed to create decision-making paralysis during key operational windows
Encrypted point-to-point broadcast channels sold or given to protected individuals and organizations as secure communication infrastructure
Electronic warfare harassment of Vantablack Media broadcast infrastructure using modified Arcturus Defense Solutions surplus equipment
Parish-level recruitment through broadcast content — Null Sermons broadcasts contain embedded recruitment signals detectable only to individuals with specific augmentation configurations
Physical signal node installation inside Circuit district infrastructure, maintained by Parish logistics cells
Commissioned operations: accepting payments to run targeted broadcast campaigns against specific corponations or individuals on behalf of clients
resources: Pastoral's original Arcturus Defense Solutions electronic warfare hardware, modified for civilian broadcast applications
Substation Null primary broadcast facility with transmission range covering approximately 60% of Meridian 88's augmentation infrastructure
Fabrication labs in Old Harbor capable of producing synthetic documents, neural credential forgeries, and deep fake media indistinguishable from authentic sources
Distributed signal node network throughout the Circuit district
Stockpile of decommissioned Arcturus Defense Solutions broadcast suppression countermeasures
Broadcast encryption protocols derived from Arcturus military communication standards — effectively uncrackable by commercial security systems
Significant public goodwill among Tier-3 and Tier-4 citizens, functioning as a form of soft intelligence network

relationships.description: Null Sermons and Vantablack Media are in a state of continuous low-intensity information warfare. Vantablack has dedicated a full suppression division to countering Null Sermons broadcasts and has filed seventeen Meridian Quorum enforcement actions against the faction. Null Sermons has responded by broadcasting fabricated internal Vantablack memos and running deep fake operations targeting senior Vantablack executives. The conflict shows no sign of resolution.

Arcturus officially regards Null Sermons as a criminal organization operating stolen military hardware. Unofficially, elements within Arcturus's electronic warfare division have been quietly supplying Pastoral with surplus equipment and technical documentation for years — seemingly motivated by a combination of personal loyalty to Pastoral and the intelligence value of watching a non-state actor stress-test military broadcast systems in a live urban environment.

TESSERA has been a primary Null Sermons broadcast target since 2182, when Pastoral ran a six-week neural-feed campaign exposing TESSERA's Tier-4 citizen augmentation suppression program. TESSERA's response was a physical assault on what they believed was Null Sermons' primary facility — they hit the wrong building, killing three unaffiliated civilians, which Null Sermons broadcast in its entirety.

The two factions respect each other's capabilities and share a broadly aligned interest in disrupting corporate information control, but their methods create friction. The Confessional regards Null Sermons' broadcast approach as reckless and harm-index-incompatible. Null Sermons regards the Confessional's careful, slow leverage approach as insufficiently disruptive. They have cooperated on three documented operations and declined to cooperate on many more.

The Meridian Quorum has classified Null Sermons as a Tier-1 public order threat and maintains an active enforcement operation against them. Null Sermons broadcasts regularly include fabricated Quorum internal communications designed to create internal distrust within the organization.

Null Sermons operates significant hardware inside Substation Null, which is Ouroboros Energy infrastructure. Ouroboros is aware of the occupation and has chosen not to act, apparently calculating that the cost of a suppression operation outweighs the benefit of reclaiming a largely decommissioned facility. Null Sermons does not broadcast against Ouroboros as part of an informal non-aggression understanding.

Null Sermons occasionally contracts Ghost Ronin operatives for physical security operations around broadcast node installations and, rarely, for kinetic action against corporate suppression teams. The Ghost Ronin find Null Sermons' theological aesthetic irritating but their payment reliable.

story_hooks: Pastoral has gone silent for eleven days — unprecedented. The Deacons are running the faction by committee and concealing the absence from the broader membership. Someone needs to find Pastoral before the silence becomes permanent, or before the Deacons decide they prefer the new arrangement.

A Null Sermons broadcast has gone catastrophically wrong: a memory architecture operation seeded false records into Lazarus Pharmaceuticals' drug trial database, and patients are now receiving incorrect treatments. Deacon Palimpsest insists the operation was sabotaged from inside. The players need to find the source of the corruption before the death toll rises and before Lazarus traces the operation back to Substation Null.

A Parish operating in the Circuit has intercepted a fragment of what appears to be an Arcturus Defense Solutions internal communication describing a next-generation broadcast suppression system specifically designed to counter Null Sermons' injection technique. The Parish wants to hand it to Pastoral. Someone inside Arcturus wants to make sure it never arrives.

Vantablack Media has offered a senior Null Sermons Deacon an extraordinary deal: full amnesty, legitimate employment, and the end of all suppression operations against the faction in exchange for Pastoral's real identity. The Deacon hasn't said yes. They haven't said no. They've been meeting with the players instead.

A Null Sermons broadcast has gone viral across Tier-2 and Tier-3 augmentation feeds — not because of its content, but because it contains an embedded signal that is causing temporary sensory dissociation in anyone who receives it. The broadcast was not authorized by any Parish or Deacon. Someone is using Null Sermons' infrastructure and aesthetic to run an operation the faction knows nothing about.

Deacon Chirp approaches the players with a commission: inject a specific broadcast package into the Vantage Meridian Corporate Campus internal network during a scheduled TESSERA-Ringo Corponation merger summit. The package, she says, contains evidence of a Ringo fraud operation. What she doesn't say is that the package also contains a secondary payload she doesn't know about — and the person who added it has been inside Null Sermons for two years.
